explanation: The Dijon article opens its § Prelude with the claim: "After the French defeats at Novara (6 June) and Guinegatte (16 August), Louis XII anticipated a counter-attack by the Imperial armies on France’s own soil." Novara is the defeat that emptied Italy of the French army, and la Trémoille was recalled from Italy to govern Dijon. The invasion of Burgundy came three months later. `enabled`: the article says the defeat opened France to a counter-attack. It does not say the defeat made this siege inevitable. Probable: Wikipedia alone, and the sentence carries no citation of its own.
